title: UART Framed Parser
shortDescription: Parse a byte stream into UART frames with sync, length, and checksum.

templates.notes: Keep parser state explicit; frames may arrive one byte at a time.

visibleCases.name: single valid frame
visibleCases.explanation: The final byte is the checksum: 0x03 ^ 0x10 ^ 0x20 ^ 0x30 = 0x03. The frame is emitted after that byte is fed.

visibleCases.name: noise before sync
visibleCases.displayExpect:
emitted = true on the final byte (0x43)
frame.len = 1
frame.payload[0] = 0x42

visibleCases.name: bad checksum resets
visibleCases.explanation: Parser must recover after checksum failure.

hiddenCases.name: two frames
hiddenCases.displayInput: two valid frames back to back
hiddenCases.explanation: State must reset after frame completion.
